fields: [pic=6]<size=18>Oh thank heavens you two are ok!</size>
[pic=6]When you guys didn’t show up, we were worried sick!
Ah y-yeah… Other critters needed help…
[pic=4]With what? Some documents? <waitfor=0.5>A couple items here and there?
[pic=4]That was very dangerous! Little Mabel could’ve gotten swept away out there!
[pic=6]Where did you guys end up staying last night?
[pic=7]We took shelter in the rock house next door.
[pic=6]It was a little tight, but we made it work!
[pic=7]From the smell of it, you two did a lot more than take shelter…
Mabel wasn’t kidding when she said it was "a little tight."
[pic=2]PFFFT. <waitfor=0.5>Wow <waitfor=0.5>ok, Mabel will have to fill me in on that later!
[pic=6]So that was quite some storm, eh?
Yeah, what do you two make of it?
[pic=8]We’ve had some pretty heavy storms before, similar to this…
[pic=8]But this one came on so suddenly, I didn’t even notice the clouds…
[pic=6]Yeah, one moment we were talking with Charlotte. <waitfor=0.5>Then a light drizzle started. <waitfor=0.5>Then it was <size=18>POURING!</size>
[pic=8]I’m… <waitfor=0.5>Kinda worried it’s related to the runes?
[pic=6]Oh darling, don’t start worrying about that again…
[pic=3]Oh, we’re also looking for a light source though. Do you have a lantern or something?
[pic=1]I did! It helped with night foraging, but it was bulky, so I stopped using it.
[pic=2]Maverick might have something though. Or Bucky!
Ok thanks! We’ll check with them.
[pic=4]And don’t <wave a=0.1 f=8>EVER</wave> worry me like that again.
[pic=7]But for now I think we should check up on the rest of the critters. See how they held out over the night.
